captions.detailed: A tower-mounted three-branch rotary stand featuring a heavy, tiered black base and a short central tower. It carries three light-grey radial arms stacked vertically on separate collars along the tower. Each of the three arms is a single rigid member ending in a small peg, and each is jointed to rotate independently around the vertical axis of the tower.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated three-branch rotary stand with a heavy tiered black base and a central vertical tower. Mount three separate light-grey radial arms on collars along the tower, and define revolute joints for each arm so they can rotate independently around the vertical axis.
captions.factory: Construct a base using nested cylinders of decreasing radii to form a tiered stand, and extrude a central vertical cylinder to serve as the tower. For each of the three arms, construct a collar using a combination of a cylinder and a lofted or extruded profile for the radial arm extension, topped with a small peg. Define three separate revolute joints along the vertical Z-axis, connecting each arm collar to the fixed tower base at distinct heights.
